why: Keeps the name and takes the zoom away. The entry exists because issue #327's fifth criterion names 200% zoom: a 1280x800 screen at 200% gives the page 640x400 CSS px, which is the tightest landscape a desktop player can produce. Restoring the full width leaves a label claiming a zoom reading that is no longer being taken, and the viewport count, the summary line and every other check stay exactly as they were -- so this is the version of the mistake nothing else would show.
killedBy: hit-sweep.mjs: the viewports issue #327 criterion 5 names (issue #933) sweeps the 200% zoom reading, whose CSS width is half the screen it stands for
